## Summary
- add a deterministic Markdown renderer over the committed COLDSTART_RECONCILIATION.json (offline; no raw pack, no live DB)
- emit docs/05-audit-reports/task-orchestrator/coldstart-reconciliation-20260622.md (done/blocked/queue/supervisor/operator-gate + active root, with PR/proof refs)
